recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not reintroduce a ClaimResponse diagnosis-child packageCode; any future FM change to DRG/package billing modeling should be handled as a new post-FHIR-29688 tracker.
issue_request: FHIR-11375 is a Published/Persuasive with Modification FM change request from the DSTU2 ballot asking for a consistent term for the DRG, bundle, or equivalent package code in ClaimResponse. The final resolution narrowed the requested change to renaming diagnosis drg to packageCode.
initial_application: The Jira-tagged commit d06f8787e6 (Tracker #11375, 11376, 11391, 11392) renamed historical Claim and ExplanationOfBenefit diagnosis drg elements to packageCode and updated their package billing text. It did not change ClaimResponse, and historical grep around that commit did not find a ClaimResponse diagnosis drg/packageCode child in the ClaimResponse spreadsheet source.
additional_context: ClaimResponse is active in source/fhir.ini. The related FHIR-11376, FHIR-11391, and FHIR-11392 audit commits are already on the combined branch. The later Published/Persuasive FM issue FHIR-29688 superseded the diagnosis-child packageCode placement by adding diagnosisRelatedGroup at the root of Claim, ClaimResponse, and ExplanationOfBenefit and requiring removal of resource.diagnosis.packageCode; commit acb64eec3c added the current ClaimResponse root element.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. The current authoritative ClaimResponse StructureDefinition defines ClaimResponse.diagnosisRelatedGroup as the package billing code, and searches found no ClaimResponse.diagnosis.drg or ClaimResponse.diagnosis.packageCode element to rename.
